description: Current courier geoposition for an active claim: position {lat, lon, timestamp (unix), accuracy, speed (m/s), direction (0–360°, clockwise from north)} and route_points with sharing_link. Errors: 404 — claim or courier position not found, 409 — the claim is not active or no courier is assigned.

claim_id.description: Claim id (claim_id, 32–64 characters) from the create_claim or search_claims response.
